finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: Attacker-controlled input could be crafted to execute arbitrary commands on the server.
finding.assumptions: The server processes the received data in a way that allows command execution. The server-side code is not shown.

finding.title: Buffer Overflow or Underflow
finding.trigger: If the input exceeds BUFFER_SIZE, it could lead to buffer overflow.
finding.assumptions: The user can input more than BUFFER_SIZE characters.
